# AI unboxing and ASMR product video from two photos — Seedance 2.5

**A box photo and a product photo become a hands-only unboxing clip with native ASMR taps, crinkle and lid pop, no music.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_8641da59f6ec.webp" alt="Top-down hands-only unboxing on a wooden desk: the lid lifts off a white box and a blue pet nail clipper is taken out of its tray." width="480"></p>

Turns product photos into an unboxing or ASMR video ad on varg: hands-only, top-down or POV, the box tapped, opened and the product lifted out and switched on, with native ASMR sound (taps, crinkle, lid pop) and no music, in timed VISUAL / ACTION / SOUND blocks on Seedance 2.5 with the box and the product as references. Unboxing has the highest winner rate of any Meta ad format (9.8%, Motion 2026) while only 2.1% of ads use it. Use when a seller (TikTok Shop, Shopify, dropshipping, Amazon) asks for an unboxing video, an ASMR or satisfying product video, "open the box" content, a packaging reveal, or a hands-only product demo made from photos. Not for talking-head UGC (use ai-ugc-ad-video), the full 60 s guide reel (varg-dropship-reel) or a studio spin of the product alone (product-photo-to-video).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-unboxing-video                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills varg-unboxing-video --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 83 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

- "Make a 10-second top-down ASMR unboxing of my LED clipper from ./box.jpg and ./product.jpg"
- "I don't have packaging photos — make a box for my earbuds and an unboxing video ending with them switching on"
- "Luxury macro unboxing of our perfume on marble, 15 seconds, 9:16"
